'''Boorka's Palace''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Boorka]]. It was located near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Osnoe]] and was Boorka's base of operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, Boorka struck a deal with the Separatists to give them secret information he possessed about the Republic in exchange for the destruction of a [[Republic spaceport (Mos Osnoe)|Republic spaceport]], allowing him to profit greatly. However the Hutt was [[Second Battle of Tatooine|attacked]] by Republic forces later, who [[Death/Legends|killed]] him and destroyed the palace.

==Description==
Boorka's Palace was a building owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Boorka]], constructed near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Osnoe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was cylindrical in shape with a [[Color/Legends|gray]] roof, with four towers placed around the building.<ref name="GB:CC" />

==History==
Boorka used the palace as his base of operations during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the early stages of the war, Boorka met with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] of the Separatists to discuss a deal between Boorka and the Confederacy. The Hutt had valuable information relating to the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]], a secret Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] which he was selling to the Separatists in exchange for the [[First Battle of Tatooine|destruction]] of a Republic [[Republic spaceport (Mos Osnoe)|spaceport]] interfering with the profits of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the organization to which Boorka belonged. When the Separatists destroyed the spaceport Boorka was able to expand his influence on Tatooine, attracting the attention of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]], under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], who was told of Boorka's actions by his Hutt rival, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The Republic [[Second Battle of Tatooine|attacked]] Boorka's palace,<ref name="GB:CC" /> and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Hutt.<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' confirms [[Boorka]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' as [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity.</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The Republic Army also destroyed Boorka's Palace.<ref name="GB:CC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Boorka's Palace appears in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. The palace appears in two levels, the first is the third level of the Separatist campaign, "Perilous Dealings," where the player meets with Boorka at his palace. In the third level of the Republic campaign, "Never trust a Hutt," the player has the option of destroying Boorka's palace while completing the optional objective to defeat the Hutt. The palace is also identical to the model for [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] used in the same game.<ref name="GB:CC" />
